mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 63 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park with clear skies under a waning crescent moon, and we expect an overnight low of 55 degrees with no rain.

City Hall reminds everyone that the public works department handles everything from street maintenance to water utilities. You can stay informed by subscribing to the city newsletter, which offers updates on all ongoing development projects, including upcoming agenda items for the plan commission.
There is plenty to do in Verona tomorrow, including yoga at Insight Wellness, trivia at the Bogey Factory, and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park.
On October 3, a 19-year-old Verona man was arrested for possession of a stolen firearm and other charges after an officer pulled him over for an expired registration.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for the night. Today's feature was Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie, but tomorrow, we welcome the day with Turtle Cheesecake when the store opens at 10:00 AM.
